verdict.rationale: Capsule CRM documents its own recurrence feature: tasks can repeat daily, weekly or monthly. Tracks chain a series of tasks into a sequence. Both are human to-do items rather than automated jobs, and Tracks have no documented recurring schedule. missing for 10: scheduled execution of automated workflows or jobs, cron-style or custom recurrence rules, API or programmatic scheduling of recurring automations, recurring schedules for Tracks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Set a task to repeating daily, weekly or monthly.
Use Tracks to set up a series of tasks that each become active one after the other.
